sql_query:
SELECT
  COALESCE(g.geolocation_city, s.seller_city) AS city,
  ABS(SUM(oi.freight_value)) AS total_logistic_fee,
  ABS(SUM(oi.price)) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN sellers s
  ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
LEFT JOIN geolocation g
  ON s.seller_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
GROUP BY COALESCE(g.geolocation_city, s.seller_city)
ORDER BY city;
